requiredFacts.criticality: Exact owner signature, private topic share, peer identity, current role grant, full durable cause, known zero-cost operation, claim bounds, ownership, stop and held-secret checks. Peer statements cannot grant authority.
requiredFacts.preservesInput: Existing hook trace retains requests; the encrypted journal retains admitted cause and peer payloads. Failed or unknown dispatch retains its stable preparation; no automatic resend. Recoverable staging is reclaimed after replication; accepted payloads and authenticated custody proofs stay in the encrypted journal.
